setData.questStepSummary:
Although you have acquired access to the Altar from Dean Rebecca, she says that an unidentified signal has been disrupting their systems since just before your arrival.
The disruption is outside of the Aionian Safe Zone around the Altar, so she has been hesitant to send her people to locate its source, but has released field monitor balloons to remotely triangulate the signal. 

Ghost might be able to boost the field monitor's signal to punch through the interference and find the source of the signal.

displayProperties.name: The Territory War Begins

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary: Dark Matter Ingots are earned by completing Jobs and Contracts. Deposit them in a Syndicate's War Chest to increase your standing with them.
